$Comment: Martha's Neighbor: reach Friendly with Martha, the rank her favor calls Neighbor, and collect her
Earned once and kept. Favor with Martha carries from one feast to the next, so this file has no
Parent: the yearly skeleton would mint a copy each year that every Neighbor collects again at login
for nothing. It carries no full_table tag either, which keeps it out of The Full Table.
REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's favor has reached, each time their favor changes and
when they log in. Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey
words the step with Martha's own rank name. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id
harvest_feast_marthas_neighbor, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
The gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page until the player collects it: Harvest Coins,
Bundles of Hay to decorate with, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token, a quarter more XP in every
skill for half an hour, which the player starts when it suits them. The token row's own Requires, the
